x: F Ball the winner of the sprint is quite a promising runner and being young (he can still compete in the under 18 event) should continue to improve. The Club mile also went to a young member, B.
Several of our "Juniors" ran well, including Button, Tom Pritchard, Davis, Field and others. A new member, Robertshaw, is promising and will do much better.
Several members have been shewing up in various championships. On the 10th "Business house day," we found B. C Button running in the London Shipping C.C.C., and finishing 2nd.
Many of our members of ten years or so standing will remember B.
We have received good wishes from our former member now in Australia, B.
Our Gazette goes to Singapore, to Iran, to Bert Button, one-time member, in New South Wales, to a pre-war member now in New York; and it would be interesting to hear of other "long-distance" readers.
I understand that Derrick Burfitt has been seen on the films in N.S.W. I wonder if our old member, B.
Bert Button, writing from Sydney, New South Wales, sends greetings to the Club and all those he knew years ago.
